b.x: One sign, now

A stroke warning is sudden. Not ‘it got worse this week’. One side fell, speech went, the world spins and will not stop, one eye went dark, the headache is the worst of a life: call emergency. Stroke field: what to do. This field is only the eye. The young too. Women too. A child is rare, but it exists. ‘Stress’ does not explain a dead side.
DON'T
Do not wait for all six. Do not sleep ‘to see’. Do not ask the neighbour for aspirin. It passed in ten minutes: still an emergency. A TIA warns of the large one.
FAST and what FAST misses
01 Face. A crooked smile. A mouth on one side. An eye that will not close the same.
02 Arm. One will not rise. A hand that will not squeeze. A leg that drags all at once.
03 Speech. It drags, swaps a letter, cannot find the word, does not understand the simple.
04 Time. The last normal hour. Tell emergency. Stroke field.
05 Eyes. Dark on one side, double, a field that vanishes. It is not ‘tired eyes’.
06 Balance. A fall with no trip, a spin that will not pass, cannot walk a line.
07 A sudden headache, ‘the worst’, with vomit or a stiff neck: call. It may be a bleed.
Signs the house lets pass
Tingling or numbness on one side only, sudden. Face, arm, leg.
Sudden confusion. Does not know where they are. Does not recognise the house.
A strong hiccup that will not stop, nausea with the spin, a ‘stuffed’ voice: still an emergency if it came all at once.
After a stroke: the same sign again. Post-stroke field. It is not ‘residual’.
NOTE
Dizziness alone, without the rest, may be the ear. Dizziness + one side + speech + eye = emergency. Doubt: call. Educational. Stroke field. The eye uses it.
